The control button activates the passenger compartment fan properly but the temperature of the air is not correct.

1

SYSTEM PRESSURE CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Connect the climate control system to the special repressurizing equipment and check the system pressures

See Test 5040OB CHECK ON OPERATION OF AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM (PRESSURE)

Check that the engine cooling fan is working properly.

Move on to Step 2

1.System pressure not correct.

1.Restore the correct system pressure value

2.Refrigerant pressurizing too low or too high

2.Restore correct refrigerant level

Op. 0010T84 COOLANT FOR AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM - DEHYDRATE AND REPRESSURIZE

3.Incorrect operation of engine cooling fan

3.Carry out the test

See Test 5040AB REFRIGERANT CIRCUIT CHECK

2

CHECK ON CORRECT MANUAL CONTROL OPERATION

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Before starting, check the following conditions: ambient temperature around 20 °C, vehicle with doors and windows closed (during the cooling and measuring of the temperature) With the engine on, at ambient temperature (check with the diagnostic equipment that the passenger compartment temperature sensor reading is about 20 °C), with the compressor on, adjust the temperature to the maximum cold position, the distribution to the front position, the selector at the 2nd speed and the outside air intake function. After around 5 minutes in these conditions check, using the diagnostic equipment, that the temperature value decreases: from the initial temperature of about 20 °C (ambient temperature) gradually decreasing to a temperature of about 6-10°C at the front distribution air vents. Check whether the temperature of the air coming out of the vents actually alters (becoming colder)

End of diagnosis

The air coming out of the climate control vents does not feel colder

Move on to Step 3

3

PIPE AND FILTER CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that the air conditioning high and low pressure pipes are not blocked.

Move on to Step 4

1.Pipe from compressor to condenser obstructed.

1.Replace the pipe from the compressor to the condenser

Op. 5040A50 PIPE FROM AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR TO CONDENSER - R+R

2.Pipe from condenser to expansion valve obstructed.

2.Replace pipe from condenser to expansion valve.

4

CONDENSER CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that the condenser is not blocked or fouled with mud.

Move on to Step 5

1.Condenser obstructed

1.Replace the condenser

Op. 5040A40 AIR CONDITIONING CONDENSER - R+R

2.Condenser fouled

2.Remove the fouling by washing

5

CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION OF MIXTURE ACTUATOR KINEMATIC MECHANISM

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Visually inspect that the mixture actuator is working properly from the climate control system control unit temperature control knob. Check whether the control on the control unit is interrupted when measuring the electrical continuity in the test.

Op. 5040DH SEQUENTIAL PROCEDURE FOR CHECKING OPERATION OF MIXTURE AND DISTRIBUTION ACTUATORS

End of diagnosis

1.Incorrect operation of actuator

1.Replace the mixture actuator

Op.

2. Physical impediment to flap rotation

2. Replace the control unit

3.Incorrect operation of the control actuator on the climate control unit.

3.Replace the climate control system control unit

CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION OF CLIMATE CONTROL NODE

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Before starting, check the following conditions: ambient temperature around 20 °C, vehicle with doors and windows closed (during the cooling and measuring of the temperature)

With the engine on, at ambient temperature (check with the diagnostic equipment that the passenger compartment temperature sensor reading is about 20 °C), with the compressor on, place the control unit to AUTO, adjust the temperature to the maximum cold LO position, the distribution to the front position, the fan speed to 3 bars and the outside air intake function. After around 5 minutes in these conditions check, using the diagnostic equipment, that the temperature value at the air vents decreases: from the starting temperature of about 20 °C (ambient temperature) gradually decreasing to the temperature of the front distribution air vents of between 6-10 °C.

Feel whether the air coming out of the vents varies in temperature (getting colder).

The air coming out of the climate control vents does not feel colder

3

CHECK USING DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Connect the diagnostic equipment and check:

  • that there are no errors at the air mixing actuators;
  • that there are no faults in the treater air sensors;
  • that there are no faults in the outside temperature sensor;
  • that there are no faults in the passenger compartment temperature sensor;
  • that the solar sensor is working properly

See Test 5040DC CHECK ON OPERATION OF SOLAR SENSOR

Move on to Step 5

1.Error at the air mixture actuators.

1.Move on to Step 4

2.Error at treated air sensors.

2.Move on to Step 4

3.Error at the outside temperature sensor.

3.Move on to Step 4

4.Error at the passenger compartment temperature sensor.

4.Move on to Step 4

5.Solar sensor defective

5.Replace the solar sensor

See Test 5010D56 SOLAR SENSOR - R.R FOLLOWING ELECTRICAL SYSTEM CHECK

4

ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

With the engine switched off, remove the control unit from the dashaboard support and disconnect the wiring connector from the control unit and check visually for any damage to the connector contacts and reconnect correctly to check for false contacts.

Check the continuity/insulation of the electrical connection:

  • of the air mixture actuators if there is an error at the mixture actuators;
  • of the sensor if there is an error at the outside temperature sensor;

Move on to Step 5

1.Electrical connections loose or damaged.

1. Renew the electrical connections

See E6020 AIR CONDITIONING

2.Electrical connection broken or not insulated.

2. Restore the continuity/insulation of the electrical connection

See E6020 AIR CONDITIONING

ACTION
